Mechanistic study of progesterone-receptor truncation in pregnancy-associated myometrium. This tissue and proteolytic endpoint do not assay tumor mutations or short HLA ligands.
The primary model predicts TCR–HLA restriction. Its application to TCGA HLA loss lacks a directly measured somatic ligand endpoint and overlaps TCGA cohorts already under study.
